title: Other reports keep or forget their filters between visits as before
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • Before the release was installed, you did the steps below on Sales By Customer, Inventory Value and Work In Progress and noted for each whether the unticked location was still unticked when you came back.
  • Starting screen: the release is installed; Reports is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open Sales By Customer.
  2. In its Location filter, untick {Location-B}.
  3. Open A/R Summary.
  4. Open Sales By Customer again from the Reports menu.
  5. Read Sales By Customer's Location chip.
  6. Open Inventory Value.
  7. In its Location filter, untick {Location-B}.
  8. Open A/R Summary.
  9. Open Inventory Value again from the Reports menu.
  10. Read Inventory Value's Location chip.
  11. Open Work In Progress.
  12. In its Location filter, untick {Location-B}.
  13. Open A/R Summary.
  14. Open Work In Progress again from the Reports menu.
  15. Read Work In Progress's Location chip.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: Sales By Customer opens.
  • Step 2: Sales By Customer narrows to {Location-A}.
  • Step 3: A/R Summary opens.
  • Step 4: Sales By Customer opens again.
  • Step 5: the Location filter is kept, or forgotten, exactly as you noted for Sales By Customer before the release.
  • Step 6: Inventory Value opens.
  • Step 7: Inventory Value narrows to {Location-A}.
  • Step 8: A/R Summary opens.
  • Step 9: Inventory Value opens again.
  • Step 10: the Location filter is kept, or forgotten, exactly as you noted for Inventory Value before the release.
  • Step 11: Work In Progress opens.
  • Step 12: Work In Progress narrows to {Location-A}.
  • Step 13: A/R Summary opens.
  • Step 14: Work In Progress opens again.
  • Step 15: the Location filter is kept, or forgotten, exactly as you noted for Work In Progress before the release.

Why: the six reports must not remember filters (they reuse the shared filter parts with that switched off); the other reports must keep doing whatever they did before (Rule 96, shared component).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • Key Decisions, reuse rule: “The reuse rule. Every control on these reports reuses an existing ShopView pattern: the native filter chips, the native totals row and pinned headline column of the newer reports, the existing location-switch prompt, the design system's chevron icon. Nothing new is drawn. Basis: d-reuse-existing-pattern.”

From: Tech plan "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter — Technical Implementation Plan" (2026-10-21, uploaded 22 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan §7 E2E, regression re-runs: “Regression re-runs (Keep, no edits expected) when Phase 1 lands, because it changes the shared filter kit, URL sync, useReportTableQuery and the location resolver:”

From: Developer verify task SV-11597 "A/R & A/P aging — verify Phase 1: shared report kit" (updated 21 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Jira SV-11597, Check: “Inventory Value, Sales By Customer and Work In Progress: filters, links shared from the address bar, and CSV/PDF exports behave exactly as before.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 4 "Location filter and Location column" (board Location.dc.html); page 7 "Filters and call list" (board Filters.dc.html). The design draws no picture of this behaviour (all 7 boards and 45 figures checked); the case follows the PRD.
